description_en: Queries the rules in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-config-rules --config-rule-state ACTIVE --compliance-type COMPLIANT --risk-level 1 --compliance-pack-id cp-fe416457e0d900220000 --config-rule-name The_name_of_the_rule. --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --keyword ecs --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --sort-by CreateDate-Desc --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateConfigRules

parameters.help_en:
The state of the rule. Valid values:

ACTIVE: The rule is enabled.

DELETING: The rule is being deleted.

EVALUATING: The rule is being evaluated.

INACTIVE: The rule is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则运行状态。取值：
ACTIVE：应用中。
DELETING：删除中。
EVALUATING：评估中。
INACTIVE：已停用
parameters.name: config_rule_state

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available
parameters.help_zh:
规则合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: high

2: medium

3: low
parameters.help_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The ID of the compliance package
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

fields.help_en:
The key of a resource tag.

You can add a maximum of 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

最多支持绑定20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of a resource tag.

You can add a maximum of 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

最多支持绑定20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can add a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The keyword for a fuzzy query.

The keyword can be a rule ID, rule name, rule description, or rule template identifier
parameters.help_zh:
查询关键字。

支持对规则ID、规则名称、规则描述和规则模板标识等进行模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The resource type to be evaluated by the rule
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The method that is used to sort the rules. By default, this parameter is not specified. Set the value to `CreateDate-Desc` to sort the rules in descending order of their creation time
parameters.help_zh: 默认不传值。当前支持：`CreateDate-Desc`，代表新创建的规则排序靠前
parameters.name: sort_by

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account to which the rule belongs

AutomationType.description_en: The remediation type. The value is fixed to OOS, which indicates Operation Orchestration Service
AutomationType.description_zh: 修正类型。仅支持OOS（运维编排）

ComplianceType.description_en:
The summary of the compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available
ComplianceType.description_zh:
规则合规评估的摘要结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

Count.description_en: The number of resources that are evaluated based on the summary of the compliance evaluation
Count.description_zh: 规则评估摘要结果对应的评估资源数

ConfigRuleState.description_en:
The state of the rule. Valid values:

ACTIVE: The rule is enabled.

DELETING: The rule is being deleted.

EVALUATING: The rule is being evaluated.

INACTIVE: The rule is disabled
ConfigRuleState.description_zh:
规则运行状态。取值：
ACTIVE：应用中。
DELETING：删除中。
EVALUATING：评估中。
INACTIVE：已停用

CreateBy.description_en: The information about the creator of the rule

AggregatorId.description_en: The ID of the account group

AggregatorName.description_en: The name of the account group

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package

CompliancePackName.description_en: The name of the compliance package
CompliancePackName.example: The name of the compliance package.

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the management account that created the rule

CreatorName.description_en: The name of the management account that created the rule
CreatorName.description_zh: 创建规则的管理账号名称

CreatorType.description_en: The type of the creator. The value is fixed to AGGREGATOR
CreatorType.description_zh: 创建规则的类型。仅支持AGGREGATOR（账号组）

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the rule was created. The time is displayed in UTC+8

ResourceTypesScope.description_en: The types of the resources that are evaluated by the rule. Multiple resource types are separated by commas (,)
ResourceTypesScope.description_zh: 规则评估的资源类型，多个资源类型半角逗号（,）分隔

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: high

2: medium

3: low
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

SourceIdentifier.description_en:
The identifier of the rule.

If the rule is a managed rule, the value of this parameter is the identifier of the rule template.

If the rule is a custom rule, the value of this parameter is the ARN of the function
SourceIdentifier.description_zh:
规则标识符。

如果是规则模板，该参数为规则模板标识。

如果是自定义规则，该参数为函数ARN

SourceOwner.description_en:
The owner of the rule. Valid values:

CUSTOM_FC: a custom rule.

ALIYUN: a managed rule
SourceOwner.description_zh:
规则来源的归属。取值：

CUSTOM_FC：自定义规则。

ALIYUN：规则模板

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据行数
